changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tc_game_jokers (gamesessionid, deviceid, type, granted, used, updatedat) SELECT gamesessionid, deviceid, 'fakePing', SUM(granted), SUM(used), MAX(updatedat) FROM tc_game_jokers WHERE type IN ('fakeTimetable', 'fakeSpeedhunt') GROUP BY gamesessionid, deviceid
DELETE FROM tc_game_jokers WHERE type IN ('fakeTimetable', 'fakeSpeedhunt')
UPDATE tc_game_joker_reservations SET type = 'fakePing' WHERE type IN ('fakeTimetable', 'fakeSpeedhunt')
UPDATE tc_game_requests SET type = 'jokerFakePing' WHERE type IN ('jokerFakeTimetable', 'jokerFakeSpeedhunt')
